records.question: Delaney has to catch a bus that leaves at 8:00. a.m to school every day. He always takes 30 minutes to reach the pick-up point from his home. One day he woke up late and left his home at 7:50. How much time did he miss the bus by when he reached the pick-up point?
records.response:
Delaney takes 30 minutes to reach the pick-up point, so he will reach the pick-up point at 7:50 + 30 minutes = 8:20 a.m.
Since the bus leaves at 8:00 a.m., Delaney missed the bus by 8:20 - 8:00 = 20 minutes.
#### 20

records.question: Marites internet speed is 10 megabits per second and her monthly internet bill is $20. Marites is planning to upgrade her service and choosing between 20 Mbps and 30 Mbps. If the price of the 30 Mbps is twice the amount of her current monthly bill and the price of the 20 Mbps is $10 more than her current monthly bill, how much will she save per year if she chooses the 20 Mbps than 30 Mbps?
records.response:
Marites chooses the 20 Mbps plan which costs $10 more than her current monthly bill.
Thus, she will pay 20+10 = $30 per month.
Her yearly bill will be 30*12 = $360.
If she chooses the 30 Mbps plan, her monthly bill will be 2*20 = $40.
Her yearly bill will be 40*12 = $480.
Thus, she will save 480-360 = $120 per year if she chooses the 20 Mbps than 30 Mbps.
#### 120
